newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt sells contracting firm to Arab investors.
newsitem.headline: Egypt sells contracting firm to Arab investors.

text.p: The Egyptian state has sold off 450,000 shares, or 90 percent, of its share in Nasr Public Utilities and Installation to Arab investors for 36 million pounds ($10 million), corporate sources said on Monday.
The sources, speaking to Reuters, gave no further details on the Arab buyers.
The firm's employees hold the remaining 10 percent.
The state's National for Construction and Development, the former holding company, had twice extended the deadline for bids for Nasr.
Egypt's Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid said the buyers had promised to keep all the employees.
The issue is a sensitive one which sometimes delays Egypt's privatisation programme.
